status: Form-specific research, internal editorial corrections and content/dictionary/audio/preservation/browser/build/production offline checks passed; native review pending.
method: Inspect publishers' and teachers' own formation/explanation sections; examples, essays, dialogue and tasks are original. Publisher tags are estimates, not an official inventory.

sources: https://japaneseexercises.com/2026/01/09/みんなの日本語中級２　第21課　文法解説・練習/
points.formation: Quoted plain proposition + と言える/と言えます; retain だ for a complete noun/na-adjective predicate. と言えるだろう softens the conclusion. A noun label may also be quoted without a complete predicate.
points.teachingChoice: A considered written evaluation, then an ordinary conversational simplification. Formation task explicitly requests a full na-adjective predicate. Potential 言える differs from hearsay passive 言われている. Bunpro tags N3; this is an intermediate bridge in N2 writing.
points.sourceCaution: Only the teacher's と言える section is used, not unrelated example typos elsewhere on the long page. Guessed Sensei URLs failed and are not counted. Adding the pattern does not guarantee the evaluation.

points.formation: Negative verb stem + ざるを得ない: する→せざる, 来る→こざる. Final 得ない can become 得ません/得なかった.
points.teachingChoice: Unavailable space or funds force an action; not uncontrolled laughter. Retrieve ないわけにはいかない without treating overlapping meanings as exclusive distractors. Explicit formation task checks the する exception.
points.sourceCaution: Both tag N2. Original romaji/translation; source example typo readings are not imported. 得る reads える here.

points.form: にすぎない / に過ぎない
points.formation: Noun/plain verb + にすぎない; noun + である variant. Na-adjective variants use explicit なだけ/である for this unit.
points.teachingChoice: Limits amount, role or scope, unlike excessive すぎる. Collected fees can pay only part of expenses; they are not equated with expenses. One cancellation is only part of the programme.
points.sourceCaution: Bunpro supplies なだけ; NIHONGO NET supplies stem/である. Variable direct adjective attachment is not a scored exclusive answer. Both tag N2.

points.formation: Plain verb/i-adjective, noun/na-adjective stem without present だ + に違いない. Past だった can remain; polite に違いありません.
points.teachingChoice: Retrieve N3 strong conviction. Bao anticipates a reaction conditional on finding a room; it is not a checked response. Present noun attachment task omits だ/な.
points.sourceCaution: Both tag N3, already taught in n3-u04; this is retrieval, not an official N2 reassignment.

points.formation: Verb/i-adjective plain; na-adjective な/である; noun direct/である + ばかりか.
points.teachingChoice: Written emphatic addition, retrieving N3 だけでなく. Descriptive second clause rather than a request. Positive and negative examples; wet material plus waiting in the cold in the reading. Interchangeable だけでなく is not rejected merely to force the target.
points.sourceCaution: MLC tags N2; JPF 旧2級 is historical categorisation. Failed Bunpro standalone URL is not counted.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: Practical fee discussion and later weather/venue enquiry. Supplementary headwords are not quotas for spoken dialogue.
editorialReview.continuity: Room free, printing three thousand, proposed fee two hundred. Full twenty attendance would bring four thousand but is hypothetical. Free first visits and budget support need permission. Later outdoor event: no room secured, call by noon, cancel this occasion if needed, consider next month separately.
editorialReview.corrections: Removed absent 原則/告知/館内 rain-scene references; added spoken 題名. Lowered recycling for a specific naturalness reason. 仮定 moved into first meet list before its question. Actual contextual glosses only. Expense/receipt relation clarified. Replies reference actual 予算/変更 rather than unrelated new words.
editorialReview.remaining: N2 whole-core review after unit 16 and independent native language/listening review.
